Terence Tao did not prove the Poincaré c.why: Accounts of the Poincaré conjecture credit its proof to Perelman alone, and Tao's long list of results is written up everywhere without it, so 'Tao did not prove it' is what those accounts state by naming Perelman. It is the plain contrast people write ('Perelman, not Tao, proved it'), not a conclusion reached from other facts.
